parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the correct product rule, with $ae^{2x}\sin2x+be^{2x}\cos2x$ and at least one of $a,b$ equal to 2; the printed $e^x$-slip restriction applies. [M1] Obtain $2e^{2x}\sin2x+2e^{2x}\cos2x$. [A1] Equate a derivative of the required form to zero and solve correctly for $2x$ or $x$; one rearrangement slip is allowed and degree work is allowed for the method. [M1] Obtain $x=3\pi/8$ only; CWO, $67.5^\circ$ is A0, and ignore answers outside the interval. [A1] Obtain $y=(\sqrt2/2)e^{3\pi/4}$ only, or exact simplified equivalent; CWO and ISW. [A1] Total: 5.
